title: Synthesis, Crystal Structures, Magnetic Properties, and Fluorescence of Two Heptanuclear CoIII4LnIII3 Compounds (Ln = GdIII, DyIII): Multiple Relaxation Dynamics in the DyIII Analogue

synthesis.procedure: H2L was generated in situ: 2-amino-2-methyl-1-propanol (0.045 g, 0.5 mmol) in 5 mL methanol was added dropwise to 3-methoxysalicylaldehyde (0.075 g, 0.5 mmol) in 10 mL methanol under warming, refluxed 2 h, cooled, and diluted to 25 mL (0.5 mmol H2L stock). For 1, 10 mL of this H2L solution (0.2 mmol H2L) was diluted to 15 mL with acetonitrile. Triethylamine (0.056 mL, 0.4 mmol) and Gd(NO3)3·6H2O (0.067 g, 0.15 mmol) in 2 mL methanol were added successively and stirred 20 min. Co(OAc)2·4H2O (0.050 g, 0.2 mmol) in 2 mL methanol was added and stirred 5 h. The brown mixture was filtered and the filtrate was left at ambient temperature for slow evaporation. Brown crystals were collected after a few days, washed with cold methanol, and dried in vacuo. Recrystallization by MeOH/diethyl ether solvent diffusion gave diffraction-quality crystals.

properties.summary: DC susceptibility (0.1 T, 2–300 K) of powdered 1 is consistent with three weakly antiferromagnetically coupled GdIII ions (χMT = 23.38 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K, 20.90 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K). Simultaneous χMT and M(H) fits with H = −2J(S1·S2 + S2·S3) give J = −0.010 cm−1 and gGd = 1.99. Magnetization reaches 21.54 NμB at 2 K/5 T, near the 21 NμB isotropic Gd3 saturation, and M vs H/T isotherms overlay. Solid-state DRS and methanol UV–Vis absorption bands are reported.

synthesis.procedure: Both complexes used a general protocol described in detail for 1. H2L stock was prepared as above. For 1, 10 mL H2L solution (0.2 mmol) was diluted to 15 mL with acetonitrile, treated with NEt3 (0.056 mL, 0.4 mmol) and Ln(NO3)3·6H2O in 2 mL methanol, stirred 20 min, then Co(OAc)2·4H2O (0.050 g, 0.2 mmol) in 2 mL methanol, stirred 5 h, filtered, and crystallized by slow evaporation at ambient temperature; washed with cold methanol, dried in vacuo, and recrystallized from MeOH/diethyl ether by solvent diffusion. Compound 2 was obtained analogously as the Dy analogue (yield given for 2).

properties.summary: DC data (0.1 T) show χMT = 39.90 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K falling to 32.17 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K, with M = 15.33 NμB at 2 K/5 T well below 30 NμB and non-superimposable M vs H/T isotherms, indicating anisotropy. Zero-field ac susceptibility (1–951 Hz, 3.5 Oe, 2–20 K) establishes a zero-field SMM with two well-resolved Orbach channels above ~5 K (Ueff = 51.4 cm−1, τ0 = 9.40×10−7 s SR; Ueff = 24.3 cm−1, τ0 = 6.91×10−7 s FR) plus QTM at low T. Under 2000 Oe, Ueff = 51.5 cm−1 (SR) and 28.4 cm−1 (FR). Solid-state emission (λex = 422 nm) shows DyIII 4F9/2→6HJ bands plus residual ligand emission; solution emission is ligand-only.
